subject.title: Feature/Fix: Integrate lineage discovery and shadow accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage-ledger architecture for https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/2037, or prefer and build on the narrower fork-identity and cache-invalidation approach in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118?
rationale: Both open approaches address the same accounting investigation but establish different scanner identities, cache dependencies, and long-term accounting boundaries; automation cannot safely choose or combine them.

options.title: Adopt lineage stack
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 first, require exact-head runtime proof for this slice, and then continue through the safety and validation slices.

options.title: Prefer narrow fix
options.body: Land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 and pause this stack until remaining lineage-specific failures are re-measured.

recommendation.title: Adopt lineage stack
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 first, require exact-head runtime proof for this slice, and then continue through the safety and validation slices.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner also made recent merged corrections in this scanner path and is the clearest available owner for the core architecture choice.
